config.arm_order: reps outermost; trajectories; arms forward on even reps, reversed on odd (AB/BA); accuracy from the last timed rep's fused e2e output

ckpt_cfg.arch_desc: separable: FourierFeat-MLP g(x)->R^r  x  MLP-head h(z)->R^r, hard poly BC; NO POD anywhere
ckpt_cfg.objective: incumbent weak upwind M=64, NNLS-EQ m=256 grid nodes
ckpt_cfg.timed_path: end-to-end: u0 -> span-split IC fit -> rollout_jit -> full-grid decode of all 51 states, one jit; split reported

positivity_assert.rule: min over all interior points of all training + test states >= -POS_TOL (the FOM Newton solves to ~1e-12 relative)

full.rule_matched: cheapest (newton_tol, lin_tol) at least as accurate as the arm

ex.rule_matched: cheapest (newton_tol, lin_tol) at least as accurate as the arm

tensor.rule_matched: cheapest (newton_tol, lin_tol) at least as accurate as the arm

ex_learned.rule_matched: cheapest (newton_tol, lin_tol) at least as accurate as the arm
